title: Build Your Own CRM With AI: Replace Salesforce for $0/Month in Per-Seat Fees
summary: Salesforce starts at $25/seat/mo. HubSpot at $45. For a 10-person team, that's $3,000-6,000/year for features you use 20% of. Here's how to build your own — and own it forever.
body_markdown: Plan for it from day one. Use standard data formats (CSV-exportable contacts, JSON-compatible deal records). Avoid deeply custom schemas that would be hard to map to Salesforce's object model. If you build clean, you can export your contacts, companies, and deals to Salesforce in hours when the time comes. Most teams that switch say they delayed the switch by 2–3 years — saving $6,000–$36,000 while their revenue grew to justify the Salesforce bill.
